note: Edit this file to change the Today screen's brief. 'default' is shown for any day outside Oct 1-31 2026 or with no entry here; 'days' keys are YYYY-MM-DD. One plain sentence per brief: present tense, says where to be or what matters. 'note' is an optional second sentence.
